package handlers

import (
	"context"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/transport/http/api/v1/middleware"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
)

type onboardingHTTPStub struct {
	ensureCalls, actionCalls int
	request                  domain.AssistantUIActionRequest
	session                  domain.TeacherOnboardingSession
	ensureErr                error
}

func (stub *onboardingHTTPStub) Ensure(context.Context, string) (domain.TeacherOnboardingSession, error) {
	stub.ensureCalls++
	if stub.ensureErr != nil {
		return domain.TeacherOnboardingSession{}, stub.ensureErr
	}
	if stub.session.V2 != nil || stub.session.V3 != nil {
		return stub.session, nil
	}
	return domain.TeacherOnboardingSession{Schema: domain.TeacherOnboardingSessionSchema, DialogID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", Status: domain.StudentOnboardingDraftDraft}, nil
}

func TestOnboardingHTTPHistoricalSessionUnavailableIsNonRetryableConflict(t *testing.T) {
	stub := &onboardingHTTPStub{ensureErr: domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingHistoricalSessionUnavailable}
	router := chi.NewRouter()
	router.Use(middleware.AuthMiddleware)
	router.Post("/ensure", (TeacherOnboardingHandler{Ensurer: stub}).Ensure)

	response := performOnboardingHTTP(router, "/ensure", `{"schema":"teacher-onboarding-ensure.v1"}`, true)
	if response.Code != http.StatusConflict || response.Body.String() != "{\"error\":\"historical_session_unavailable\"}\n" || response.Header().Get("Retry-After") != "" {
		t.Fatalf("status=%d retry-after=%q body=%s", response.Code, response.Header().Get("Retry-After"), response.Body.String())
	}
}

func TestOnboardingHTTPSerializesOnlyBoundedDeliveredPathOutcomeMarker(t *testing.T) {
	session, err := domain.DurableHandoffTeacherOnboardingSession(domain.TeacherOnboardingSessionV3{
		Schema: domain.TeacherOnboardingSessionV3Schema, DialogID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
		Status: domain.TeacherOnboardingSessionHandoffAccepted, Phase: domain.TeacherOnboardingPhaseReadyToStart,
		StateRef:    domain.TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef{Kind: domain.TeacherReadinessStateDraft, Version: 4},
		Terminal:    &domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminalV3{Kind: domain.TeacherOnboardingSessionHandoffAccepted, DisplayName: domain.TeacherGoBackendGoalDisplayName, ExecutionStatus: domain.TeacherOnboardingExecutionNotStarted, ContentStatus: domain.TeacherLearningContentNotCreated},
		PathOutcome: &domain.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeMarker{Kind: domain.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeMarkerKind, Status: domain.TeacherOnboardingPathOutcomeMarkerReady, DialogMessageID: "99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999"},
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	stub := &onboardingHTTPStub{session: session}
	router := chi.NewRouter()
	router.Use(middleware.AuthMiddleware)
	router.Post("/ensure", (TeacherOnboardingHandler{Ensurer: stub}).Ensure)
	response := performOnboardingHTTP(router, "/ensure", `{"schema":"teacher-onboarding-ensure.v1"}`, true)
	if response.Code != http.StatusOK || !strings.Contains(response.Body.String(), `"path_outcome":{"kind":"ONBOARDING_PATH_OUTCOME","status":"PATH_READY","dialog_message_id":"99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999"}`) || strings.Contains(response.Body.String(), "handoff_id") || strings.Contains(response.Body.String(), "execution_id") || strings.Contains(response.Body.String(), "course_id") {
		t.Fatalf("status=%d body=%s", response.Code, response.Body.String())
	}
}

func TestOnboardingHTTPSerializesSessionV2WithoutLegacyFields(t *testing.T) {
	session, err := domain.ProductAwareTeacherOnboardingSession(domain.TeacherOnboardingSessionV2{
		Schema: domain.TeacherOnboardingSessionV2Schema, DialogID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
		Status: domain.TeacherOnboardingSessionPlanningReady, Phase: domain.TeacherOnboardingPhaseReadyToStart,
		StateRef: domain.TeacherStudentReadinessStateRef{Kind: domain.TeacherReadinessStateDraft, Version: 4},
		Terminal: &domain.TeacherOnboardingTerminal{Kind: domain.TeacherOnboardingSessionPlanningReady, DisplayName: domain.TeacherFoundationGoalDisplayName},
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	stub := &onboardingHTTPStub{session: session}
	router := chi.NewRouter()
	router.Use(middleware.AuthMiddleware)
	router.Post("/ensure", (TeacherOnboardingHandler{Ensurer: stub}).Ensure)
	response := performOnboardingHTTP(router, "/ensure", `{"schema":"teacher-onboarding-ensure.v1"}`, true)
	if response.Code != http.StatusOK || !strings.Contains(response.Body.String(), `"schema":"teacher-onboarding-session.v2"`) || strings.Contains(response.Body.String(), "draft_version") || strings.Contains(response.Body.String(), "current_prompt") {
		t.Fatalf("status=%d body=%s", response.Code, response.Body.String())
	}
}
func (stub *onboardingHTTPStub) ApplyAction(_ context.Context, _ string, request domain.AssistantUIActionRequest) (domain.AssistantUIActionResult, error) {
	stub.actionCalls++
	stub.request = request
	return domain.LegacyAssistantUIActionResult(domain.AssistantUIActionResultPayload{Schema: domain.AssistantUIActionResultSchema, Applied: true, Status: domain.StudentOnboardingDraftDraft, DraftVersion: 1}), nil
}

func TestOnboardingHTTPStrictContractsAndTrustedActor(t *testing.T) {
	stub := &onboardingHTTPStub{}
	router := chi.NewRouter()
	router.Use(middleware.AuthMiddleware)
	handler := TeacherOnboardingHandler{Ensurer: stub, Actions: stub}
	router.Post("/ensure", handler.Ensure)
	router.Post("/actions", handler.ApplyAction)
	ensure := performOnboardingHTTP(router, "/ensure", `{"schema":"teacher-onboarding-ensure.v1"}`, true)
	if ensure.Code != http.StatusOK || ensure.Header().Get("Cache-Control") != "no-store" || stub.ensureCalls != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("ensure=%d %s", ensure.Code, ensure.Body.String())
	}
	actionBody := `{"schema":"assistant-ui-action.v1","dialog_id":"33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333","message_id":"44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444","message_version":1,"block_id":"onboarding.direction.d0.v1","action_id":"direction.backend","idempotency_key":"55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555"}`
	action := performOnboardingHTTP(router, "/actions", actionBody, true)
	if action.Code != http.StatusOK || stub.actionCalls != 1 || stub.request.ActionID != "direction.backend" {
		t.Fatalf("action=%d %s request=%+v", action.Code, action.Body.String(), stub.request)
	}
	for name, body := range map[string]string{"label": strings.TrimSuffix(actionBody, "}") + `,"label":"Backend"}`, "value": strings.TrimSuffix(actionBody, "}") + `,"value":"backend"}`, "unknown ensure": `{"schema":"teacher-onboarding-ensure.v1","student_id":"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"}`, "trailing": actionBody + ` {}`, "oversize": `{"schema":"assistant-ui-action.v1","padding":"` + strings.Repeat("x", 5<<10) + `"}`} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			path := "/actions"
			if name == "unknown ensure" {
				path = "/ensure"
			}
			response := performOnboardingHTTP(router, path, body, true)
			if response.Code != http.StatusBadRequest {
				t.Fatalf("status=%d body=%s", response.Code, response.Body.String())
			}
		})
	}
	unauthorized := performOnboardingHTTP(router, "/ensure", `{"schema":"teacher-onboarding-ensure.v1"}`, false)
	if unauthorized.Code != http.StatusUnauthorized {
		t.Fatalf("unauthorized status=%d", unauthorized.Code)
	}
}

func performOnboardingHTTP(handler http.Handler, path, body string, authorized bool) *httptest.ResponseRecorder {
	request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, path, strings.NewReader(body))
	if authorized {
		request.Header.Set("X-User-ID", "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111")
		request.Header.Set("X-User-Role", "STUDENT")
	}
	response := httptest.NewRecorder()
	handler.ServeHTTP(response, request)
	return response
}
